Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : Eligibility of Tenderer : -
1. The minimum number of years of General Experience of the tenderer for the construction works as prime Contractor or Sub-
contractor or Management contractor shall be 10 years.
2. The minimum specific experience as a prime Contractor in construction works of at least 01 (One) contract of similar nature of
building having RCC frame Structure(including electrical, sanitary, plumbing, fire protection and fire-fighting works) with Basement
of minimum 14 storied height successfully completed within the last 05 years, with a value of at least Tk. 4500 Lacs in any
Government, Semi-Government Autonomous body of Bangladesh.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk.50.00 Crores over the best 3 years in the last 05
years. As an evidence of average annual construction turnover, The tenderer shall submit attested copies of work order (s),
Certificate(s) regarding successful completion of the work (s) Payment Certificate (s) and Bank statement (s) of the concerned
years along with tender documents.
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets i.e working capital or credit line (s) of the tenderer shall be Tk.1 000 lacs.
5. The PPR-2008 and its amendment will be followed by both the department and the tenderers.
6. Submit attested photocopy and Enlistment Certificate as minimum Class-I Building construction Contractor in any Government,
Semi-Government Autonomous body which is renewed up to 30th June 2017 and up to date A,B,C class license with supervisory
license from electric licensing board.
Brief Description of Works : Construction of 18 storied & 19 storied residential building with basement, pile cap, Mat foundation, underground basement, Water
tank, Septic tank, Super structure, deep tube-well sanitary and plumbing work, internal electrification work, Fire fighting &
